svg.text: Type Errors: Overhanging Tiles or Missing Coarser Tiles Violate Gcd(12, 8)
A candidate g inhabits Gcd(a, b) iff (1) g tiles a×b (Div(g) ⊆ Div(a)∩Div(b)) AND (2) every common tile divides g (Div(a)∩Div(b) ⊆ Div(g))
Bug: returning input b = 8 instead of gcd
Bug: returning a non-maximal common divisor
2×2 is too fine: misses valid common tile d = 4
Exact refinement match: both inclusions hold
TYPE ERROR 3 (Buggy Loop Step): (x, y) → (y, (x mod y) − 1) Destroys the Loop Invariant!
Suppose a buggy transition on (12, 8) computes remainder r' = (12 mod 8) − 1 = 3 instead of 4, stepping to (8, 3):
Refinement Type Checker Diagnosis at Loop Back-Edge:
Expected return type: Gcd(12, 8) where Div(12) ∩ Div(8) = {1, 2, 4}
Recursive call type: Gcd(8, 3) where Div(8) ∩ Div(3) = {1}
